text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can win
when I'm not fully in the zone like this.
choice_data_list: Even so, I believe you can win.
Even so, I believe you can win.
Are you okay with just staying defeated then?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think everything will work out just because you believe?
That part of you is just—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go believing in the next race...
like it's a given, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Stop that.
Talking down to me like you're trying to placate me... It pisses me off.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it can't be helped.
The way I am right now, of course I'd lose.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Saying it's okay to stay a loser...
That's... just wrong.
